'''Fanged Fusillade''' is a [[mod]] that increases {{D|Slash}} damage of a rifle by 20% per rank for a maximum of 120% at rank 5.

==Stats==
{| class="emodtable"
|-
! [[Mod#Mod Rank|Rank]]

|-

|-
| 3 || +80% || 9
|-
| 4 || +100% || 10
|-
| 5 || +120% || 11
|}

==Acquisition==
*This mod was originally acquired by getting 10 Exposure Points in the [[Operation: Gate Crash]] Event.
*Was available as a random end-of-mission reward from accomplishing the Endurance challenge of the ''Emergency Exit'' [[Tactical Alert]].
*Fanged Fusillade is now offered as a periodic item for sale by [[Baro Ki'Teer]] costing {{dc|375}} and ‍ {{cc|150,000}} to purchase. Note that Baro Ki'Teer's stock changes with each appearance, and this mod may not be available on a succeeding appearance.
*Fanged Fusillade also has an 8.33% chance to drop from the Eidolon Hydrolyst.

==Drop Locations==
{{DropLocations}}

==Notes==
*Can be combined with {{M|Sawtooth Clip}} to provide a 210% increase to {{D|Slash}} damage.
*When calculating total raw damage, a weapon will require a Slash damage percentage equal to 75% of its total base damage to equal the raw damage increase provided by a standard elemental mod (which increases corresponding elemental damages by 90%). The higher the Slash damage percentage over 75%, the more viable this mod will be as opposed to an elemental mod, and vice versa for lower values. These calculations only pertain to raw damage, and do not take into consideration enemy armor/flesh/shield damage multipliers.
**Examples of weapons that can use this mod effectively include: {{Weapon|Dread}}, {{Weapon|Flux Rifle}}, {{Weapon|Miter}}, and {{Weapon|Nagantaka}}.

==Trivia==
*A ''[[wikipedia:fusillade|fusillade]]'' describes a series of multiple shots fired simultaneously or in rapid succession.

==Patch History==
{{Scrollbox/Article|
{{ver|14.7}}
*Introduced along with [[Operation: Gate Crash]] Event.
}}

==See also==
*{{M|Sawtooth Clip}}, another {{D|Slash}} damage modifier for rifles.

{{Top|Orokin|Orokin|Orokin|Weapon|Weapons|Weapons|Prime|Prime|Prime|}} {{WeaponInfoboxAutomatic}} {{Codex|Banshee Prime's signature shotgun is an instrument of devastation that fires both focused and broad shots.}} The '''Euphona Prime''' is {{WF|Banshee Prime}}'s [[Signature Weapon|signature]] standalone [[Prime]] shotgun sidearm, capable of two different firing modes. The primary fire shoots a slug for longer range engagements while the [[Alternate Fire]] shoots wider spread shots for close range fights. The weapon deals extreme damage per shot, kept in check by its low magazine, slow fire rate, and difficulty to use at long distances owing to the primary fire's arcing projectile bullet and the alt-fire's massive damage fall-off. It was released alongside {{WF|Banshee Prime}} and {{Companion|Helios Prime}}. ==Characteristics== *This weapon deals primarily {{D|Impact}} on its primary fire and {{D|Slash}} damage on its alt-fire. *Primary fire shoots a long-ranged slug: **Highest base damage of all non-shotgun secondaries. **Very high [[critical chance]]. **High [[critical multiplier]]. **Pinpoint [[accuracy]] when aiming. **No damage falloff. *[[Alternate Fire]] shoots a wide-spread close-ranged buckshot: **Highest base damage of all shotgun-type secondaries. **Very high overall [[status chance]]. **Innate [[multishot]] of 10 pellets. **Has linear damage falloff from 100% to ~1% from 6m to 12m target distance (distances are affected by [[Projectile Speed]]). *Innate three {{Pol|Madurai}} polarities. {{Advantages|}} {{Disadvantages| *Primary Fire's projectile has travel time with heavy arcing. *Hip-fire is very inaccurate, roughly double the hip-fire accuracy of sniper rifles. *Alternate Fire has very large spread. }} ==Acquisition== {{PrimeTable}} {{BuildAutomatic|type=Weapon}} ===Vaultings=== *On [https://www.warframe.com/news/chroma-prime-access-ends-december-18 December 7th, 2018], it was announced that Euphona Prime, alongside {{WF|Banshee Prime}} and [[Helios/Prime|Helios Prime]], would enter the [[Prime Vault]] and be retired from the reward tables on December 18th, 2018. Any preexisting components or fully-built frames will remain as-is. ==Notes== *Currently, Euphona Prime lacks a [[Signature Weapon]] bonus with {{WF|Banshee Prime}}. *The Euphona Prime has two different firing modes with different characteristics: **Normal shots fire a projectile that primarily deals {{D|Impact}} damage with high critical stats. **Using Alternate Fire will shoot a spread of hitscan pellets akin to a shotgun, which focus on {{D|Slash}} damage and high status chance. *Its primary fire has bullet drop, and slightly spreads at long distances. It also enforces a ragdoll-like effect if a headshot is performed. ==Tips== *[[Projectile Speed]] mods will reduce the slug projectile drop, increase projectile speed, and increase the effective range of the buckshot secondary fire. ==Trivia== *Euphona Prime is the fourth standalone Prime piece of equipment, after {{Weapon|Reaper Prime}}, {{Weapon|Dakra Prime}}, and the [[Kavasa Prime Collar]], and the first standalone Prime Secondary weapon. *''[[wiktionary:euphony|Euphona]]'' is a Greek word that refers to pleasant sounds, typically letters, syllables, or words. *Euphona Prime is the first [[Signature Weapon]] to be [[prime]]d. However, Euphona Prime was implemented before signature weapon bonuses were added. *Euphona Prime is the only signature weapon to not have a common counterpart. *As of Update 25, Euphona Prime's default palette has gone from a brown, wood-like finish to a glossy white to be more in line with Orokin aesthetics. ==Bugs== *If no other Prime weapons, nor items are equipped, [[Baro Ki'Teer]] will treat players equipped with Euphona Prime in his usual mocking tone. ==Media== BansheePrimeBanner1.png EuphonaP.png|Euphona Prime in Codex. {{YouTube|https://www.youtube.com/watch?v{{=}}ZB0eKR3a45w}} {{YouTube|https://www.youtube.com/watch?v{{=}}G4rQWLKYIwc}} {{YouTube|b-WiK2cZweY}} {{SkinGallery}} ==Patch History== {{Scrollbox/Article| {{ver|32.0.7}} *Fixed the following weapons not correctly playing their intended animations between shots: **Euphona Prime - Fixed Warframe not spinning the gun between shots. {{ver|32}} ;Ammo Changes We understand the power fantasy of these weapons is very popular for some, so our first approach was to keep them powerful, but limit how often they can be used by making changes to ammo pick-up. '''''Ammo Pickup Overrides'''''
The following weapons now have ammo pickup overrides, meaning they gain less from picking up ammo. This mostly applies to AoE weapons, in hopes that players will become more deliberate with their aim to make the most of their Ammo pools. The following lists the specific ammo pick up overrides per weapon category. '''Secondary Weapon Ammo Pick Up Overrides''' 20 Ammo per Pick Up: *Euphona Prime {{ver|31.6}} *Fixed the Euphona Prime not playing the proper reload animation when the last shot in the magazine is from its alt fire. {{ver|31.0.8}} *Fixed Euphona Prime reload sound when using the gun as Secondary without a Glaive. {{ver|29.6}} *Fixed missing “spinning around your finger” animation for the Euphona Prime Alt Fire. {{ver|29.5}} *Fixed duplicate clip eject on Euphona Prime when the Oscira Pistol Skin is equipped. {{ver|27.2}} ;Greater than 100% Status having meaning: Shotguns have a unique Role here based on a very patch-work history with how they interact with Status Chance. A Shotgun that shoots 99% Status Chance would give you 35% (roughly) status per pellet. 100% Status Gives you 100% Status per pellet. This huge jump in performance happens with just a 1% gain - why? Well, to answer that we have to look at our choice to make what the UI conveys reality. It would feel broken to shoot a Shotgun with 100% Status and not see a perfect spread of Effects. In reality, to make Status consistent we have to treat Shotguns as a special case. Shotguns as a special case means we have buffed the Status Chance of all Shotguns by x3 or greater. The UI now behaves to show the reality that you are determining Status Chance per pellet. *(Undocumented) Status chance per projectile increased from 3% to 9% (alt-fire). {{ver|27.0.9}} *Added pickup text to Euphona Prime. {{ver|25.7.2}} *Fixed Euphona Prime having incorrect aimed accuracy when using the slug fire mode. As reported here: https://www.reddit.com/r/Warframe/comments/cxkb1o/euphona_prime_worse/ {{ver|25.7}} *Fixed Mirage’s Hall of Mirror clones sometimes using their Primary Fire instead of Alt Fire for the Euphona Prime. {{ver|23.0.2}} *Fixed Euphona Primes bullet spread not being based on the crosshair as a center point. {{ver|21.7}} *Increased primary fire damage of Euphona Prime in Conclave. *Reduced secondary fire damage of Euphona Damage in Conclave. {{ver|21}} *Fixed Euphona Prime’s primary fire projectile not appearing when using low particle settings. *Reduced the damage of primary and alt fire of Euphona Prime in Conclave. {{ver|20}} *Euphona Prime's alt-fire stats added to Arsenal. *Fixed Euphona Prime Alt fire not reacting to Mag's Magnetize. {{ver|19.12}} *Flight Speed Mods can now be used on the Euphona Prime. *Fixed the Euphona Prime doing no damage to ragdolled enemies. {{ver|19.11.5}} *Introduced. }} {{ver/Lu|23.0.2}} {{WeaponNav}} [[de:Euphona Prime]] [[es:Euphona Prime]] [[Category:Weapons]] [[Category:Secondary Weapons]] [[Category:Prime]] [[Category:Impact Damage Weapons]] [[Category:Update 19]] [[Category:Signature Weapons]] [[Category:Single Sidearm]] [[uk:Юфона-прайм]] [[Category:Standalone Primes]]

{{Top|Enemy|Corpus|Corpus}} {{WeaponInfoboxAutomatic}} {{Codex|Feel the kick of this Corpus shotgun as it shatters a high-yield crystal into anyone and anything standing in your way.}} '''Exergis''' is a [[Corpus]] shotgun that shatters a crystal into enemies, puncturing them with devastating {{D|Radiation}} shards. Its extremely high damage output, large [[status chance]], and reload speed make up for its single round, poor [[critical chance]], and [[critical multiplier]]. ==Characteristics== *This weapon deals primarily {{D|Slash}} damage. *Innate [[multishot]] of 3 pellets. *Innate {{Pol|Vazarin}} polarity. {{Advantages|class=Shotgun| * Highest base damage of all primary shotguns. *No auto-reload delay. *Innate [[Infinite Body Punch Through]], and 0.5 meter [[punch through]] for surfaces. }} {{Disadvantages|class=Shotgun| *Has linear damage falloff from 100% to 49.2% from 30m to 60m target distance (distances are affected by [[Projectile Speed]]). *Projectiles have travel time. *Lowest pellet count of all pellet shotguns. }} ==Acquisition== The Exergis's blueprint can be purchased from the [[Market]]. {{BuildAutomatic|type=Weapon}} ==Notes== *Although the Arsenal shows a huge accuracy increase when using {{M|Tainted Shell}}, there doesn't seem to be a notable accuracy difference in practice. ==Bugs == * {{M|Galvanized Savvy}} is multiplicative to base damage sources on direct hits. *Projectiles generated by modded multishot do not benefit from accuracy bonuses such as {{M|Tainted Shell}}. ==Tips== *As the Exergis is a single-shot weapon, its firing speed is largely determined by its reload speed. Thus, any mods that decrease firing speed can be equipped with a relatively small penalty, while those that increase it should be avoided in favor of reload speed mods. **Equipping any mod that gives (at least) +50% magazine capacity will increase the magazine capacity to 2. At +150% it goes to 3, and all the way to 4 by using all four magazine capacity mods: {{M|Primed Ammo Stock}}, {{M|Shotgun Elementalist}}, {{M|Atomic Fallout}} and {{M|Burdened Magazine}}. ***Adding {{Arcane|Primary Crux}} with its 60% Ammo efficiency, you could shoot up to 10 times (depending on luck) before needing to reload. A riven with +Magazine Capacity, and other Ammo efficiency buffs could take it even further, if unnecessarily so. **Building for higher magazine capacity lets the weapon take actual advantage of its relatively high firerate, and dramatically cuts down on its otherwise frequent reloads. *The Exergis' infinite punch through against bodies synergizes with {{A|Magnetize}} and {{D|Void}} status, causing the pellets to continually rebound towards the center of the bubble. ==Trivia== *The projectile is made from a crystal that grows as the user "reloads" the weapon, hovering between two points before being shattered and its projectiles expelled outward. Not only is this unique for any weapon in Warframe, but it makes increasing [[Multishot]] more realistic, as the weapon can simply shatter a more powerful crystal into more shards. **The crystal only grows back on reload, as such firing a second shot by having 2 in the magazine will not grow a crystal. If you have 3 in the magazine, the third shot also will have no recoil animation and actual weapon recoil will be lower on this third shot. *The weapon's name is a corruption of the word "Exert" and "[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Exegesis Exegesis]", A critical explanation of text, mainly religious text. ==Media== File:ExergisPoster.png File:Enrico-santi-enrico-santi-crpshapeblast1.jpg File:Exergis Arsenal.png|Exergis in the Arsenal File:Exergis Arsenal 2.png File:Exergis Arsenal 3.png {{VideoGallery |{{YouTube|uuSoGrvlpbM|size=300px}} |{{YouTube|OAb2TU3c-as|size=300px}} }} {{SkinGallery}} ==Patch History== {{Scrollbox/Article| {{ver|32}} ;Ammo Changes We understand the power fantasy of these weapons is very popular for some, so our first approach was to keep them powerful, but limit how often they can be used by making changes to ammo pick-up. '''''Ammo Pickup Overrides'''''
The following weapons now have ammo pickup overrides, meaning they gain less from picking up ammo. This mostly applies to AoE weapons, in hopes that players will become more deliberate with their aim to make the most of their Ammo pools. The following lists the specific ammo pick up overrides per weapon category. '''Primary Weapon Ammo Pick Up Overrides''' 15 Ammo per Pick Up: *Exergis {{ver|30.9}} *Fixed weapons with 1 bullet in their magazine (Exergis) bypassing the Fire Rate limit if equipped with a max rank Arcane Pistoleer. {{ver|27.2}} ;Greater than 100% Status having meaning: Shotguns have a unique Role here based on a very patch-work history with how they interact with Status Chance. A Shotgun that shoots 99% Status Chance would give you 35% (roughly) status per pellet. 100% Status Gives you 100% Status per pellet. This huge jump in performance happens with just a 1% gain - why? Well, to answer that we have to look at our choice to make what the UI conveys reality. It would feel broken to shoot a Shotgun with 100% Status and not see a perfect spread of Effects. In reality, to make Status consistent we have to treat Shotguns as a special case. Shotguns as a special case means we have buffed the Status Chance of all Shotguns by x3 or greater. The UI now behaves to show the reality that you are determining Status Chance per pellet. *(Undocumented) Status chance per projectile increased from 12% to 36%. {{ver|25.7.4}} *Fixed firing Exergis at the right time as Gauss’ Redline is activated causing you to be able to fire it continuously without needing to reload. {{ver|24.2}} *Introduced. }} ==See also== *{{Weapon|Plinx}}, the secondary counterpart of this weapon. *{{Weapon|Galvacord}}, the melee counterpart of this weapon. {{WeaponNav}} [[de:Exergis]] [[es:Exergis]] [[fr:Exergis]] [[Category:Update 24]] [[Category:Shotgun]] [[Category:Primary Weapons]] [[Category:Corpus Weapons]] [[Category:Semi-Automatic]] [[Category:Radiation Damage Weapons]] [[Category:Slash Damage Weapons]] [[uk:Екзерґіс]]

==Acquisition==
*Available for {{Nc|20}} from the [[Nightwave#Cred%20Offerings|Nightwave Cred Offerings]] store on a rotational basis.
*Exposing Harpoon was originally acquired by reaching Rank 20 in [[Nightwave]] during [[Nightwave/Series 2|Series 2: The Emissary]] or Rank 20 during [[Nightwave/Nora's Choice|Nora's Choice]].
**Beginning with [[Nightwave]] [[Nightwave/Nora's Mix Volume 5|Nora’s Mix: Vol. 5]], it was added to the Nightwave Cred Offerings.

==Notes==
*'''Exposing Harpoon''' is additive with similar mods. For example, with a max rank '''Exposing Harpoon''' and {{M|Point Strike}}, {{Weapon|Harpak}}'s primary fire will have a {{Math|20% {{mul}} (1 + 300% + 150%)|t=y|p=y}} critical chance.
*Duration is fixed at 15 seconds and can be refreshed.
*Although the mod description specifies ''pulling'' an enemy, activation only requires ''hitting'' an enemy with the secondary fire. This works against enemies that cannot be pulled (such as bosses) and will trigger even if the target point is invulnerable at the time of the attack.
**Does not activate when hitting the [[Condrix]].

{{Codex|Counter the dread of battle with a song of praise. Enemies cannot hurt your allies while wounded by Evensong’s arrows. Kills with Evensong empower ally weapons with Multishot.

Experience the true power of Jade's Ensemble when Evensong, Cantare, and Harmony sing together.}}
'''Evensong''' is {{WF|Jade}}'s [[Signature Weapon|signature]] bow and counterpart to [[Stalker]]'s {{Weapon|Dread}}. Shots apply empowered {{D|Puncture}} status effects and kills grant increased [[Multishot]].

==Characteristics==
*This weapon deals primarily {{D|Slash}} damage.
*Fully charged shots explode in a '''4''' meter radius on impact with a surface or enemy.
**Charged shot projectiles cannot benefit from [[Punch Through]], and will explode on the first surface or enemy hit.
**Initial hit and explosion apply status separately.
**Explosion does not need direct line of sight to deal damage and will penetrate walls.
**Can benefit from {{M|Firestorm}} ({{M|Primed Firestorm|Primed}}) and {{M|Cautious Shot}}.
**Can equip the bow-exclusive {{M|Thunderbolt}} mod.
*[[Fire rate]] mods apply double their bonuses.
*Direct hits and explosion apply '''7''' {{D|Puncture}} status effects (bypassing the normal limit of 5), reducing enemy damage by '''100%''' and increasing weapon [[Critical Chance]] that the victim receives by '''35%'''.
*Kills grant '''Evensong Devotion''', increasing [[Multishot]] by '''35%''' for '''30''' seconds to all allies within [[Affinity Range]].
**When combined with the effects of {{Weapon|Cantare}}, and {{Weapon|Harmony}}, all three buffs merge into '''Jade's Ensemble''', which lasts '''60''' seconds and increases the multishot bonus to '''70%'''.

{{Advantages|class=Bow|
}}

{{Disadvantages|class=Bow|
*Projectile has travel time with arcing.
*Explosion inflicts [[Stagger|self-stagger]].
*Explosion has a [[Enemy Body Parts|headshot]] multiplier of 1x and cannot trigger headshot conditions.
*Explosion has linear [[Damage Falloff]] from 100% to 10% from central impact.
}}

{{Acquisition|Evensong's blueprint is obtained from [[Ascension]] on [[Brutus]], [[Uranus]], at a 5% drop rate.

Alternatively, the blueprints can also be purchased from [[Ordis]] in the [[Drifter's Camp]] for 300 {{Resource|Vestigial Motes}}, awarded from Ascension in quantities of 11-13 (16-18 on [[The Steel Path]]) from mission completion and 5-7 (8-10 on The Steel Path) from the optional [[Sisters of Parvos]] objective.}}

{{BuildAutomatic|type=Weapon}}

==Notes==
*Triggering '''Evensong Devotion''' while it is already active will refresh the duration.
*Enemies killed with [[Status Effect|status effects]] inflicted by an Evensong arrow will trigger '''Evensong Devotion'''. 
**This includes enemies killed by damage-over-time status effects inflicted by the charged radial attack. 
**However, enemies killed by damage caused by area-of-effect status effects such as {{D|Gas}} clouds will not trigger it.
*Enemies that are usually capped at 4 stacks of a status, such as [[Acolytes]] and enemies with [[Overguard]], will receive 5 stacks of {{D|Puncture}} from Evensong.
*Blast radius of the radial charged attack can be increased by using {{M|Firestorm}}.
**All enemies struck by the radial attack will be inflicted with 7 stacks of {{D|Puncture}}.
**A fully charged projectile will despawn on causing a radial explosion, even if it had punch-through.
*{{M|Thunderbolt}}'s explosions will apply Evensong's [[Puncture]] passive to enemies it hits, enabling uncharged shots to apply [[Puncture]] status in a 10m radius, albeit with only a 30% chance of an explosion per projectile.
*When Evensong is shot into {{WF|Zephyr}}'s {{A|Tornado}}, instead of {{D|Puncture}} adding to the final critical chance of the weapon, it appears to get multiplied by critical chance mods.
*The specter from [[Duality]] will not apply the 7 stacks of [[Puncture]] when hitting enemies with the Evensong.

==Trivia==
*[[Wikipedia:Evensong|Evensong]] is a Christian church service that involves singing.
